artifacts.summary: All 4 plan phases completed: loosened the plan-checklist matching contract in the three in-scope implementation-agent files off the literal '**Task {P}.{N}**:' prefix, established the canonical wording location for two downstream sibling tasks, preserved annotation-suffix vocabulary byte-for-byte.

completion_data.completion_summary: Rewrote general-implementation-agent.md's Stage 4B-ii into the canonical prefix-free checklist-matching contract, and genericized the matching deviation-annotation lines in lean-implementation-agent.md and nix-implementation-agent.md, so plan-checklist items are located by their existing item text rather than an assumed literal prefix that planner-agent.md never emits.

memory_candidates.content: When an implementer-agent contract's Edit-match instruction assumes a specific plan-item title template (e.g. a literal '**Task {P}.{N}**:' prefix) that the planner producing those plans never emits, the Edit silently finds nothing and checklist items never get ticked -- with no error surfaced. The durable fix is a matching contract that locates items by their existing item text/intent with formatting-drift tolerance, explicitly forbidding byte-exact template matching, plus a single canonical, verbatim-quotable home for the wording so sibling agent files point at it rather than paraphrasing (paraphrase drift across agent files is itself a recurring failure mode).
